name: Tomato Rice
steps: Rinse rice until the water clears and soak 20 minutes; drain. Chop tomatoes and onion finely.
Heat oil, crackle mustard and cumin; add curry leaves, onion, ginger and chillies. Fry 5–6 minutes until onion softens.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. Cook 8 minutes until the tomato mixture is jammy and most moisture has evaporated.
Fold in drained rice and measured water. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on low heat 13–15 minutes. Rest covered 10 minutes, fluff and add coriander.
tips: Ripe, slightly tart tomatoes give the rice its signature flavour.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
